name: rwrtw-root
description: The root project for RWRTW libraries, tools and examples

scripts.build: npm run build -w rwrtw && npm run build -w rwrtw-decl && npm run build -w rwrtw-demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w rwrtw && npm run typecheck -w rwrtw-decl && npm run typecheck -w rwrtw-demo
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
